name_en: Aren's Last Order: To the End, Together
description: Aren's Last Order: To the End, Together (아렌의 군령 · 끝까지 함께): a commander's plain dark-blue cloak held out in one gauntleted hand over a fallen round shield lying on the ground, a thin column of warm dawn-gold light rising from the shield as if lifting it again (no emblem, no figure's face).

The Ram's Iron Head (성문 파쇄추의 쇠머리): the iron head of a siege ram — a heavy blunt cast-iron cap shaped like a plain ram's brow with curled horns, dented and scarred from blows, two thick iron bands and a broken stub of dark oak behind it, a faint dull-red glow in the dents.

The Ashen Night Locket (잿빛 밤의 목걸이): a small oval silver locket on a thin dark chain, its lid half open showing a pinch of grey ash and a single tiny pale-gold ember inside, a soft cold-silver glow (no picture or symbol inside).
